task_context.problem_statement: Tayzia and her two young daughters get haircuts.  Women’s haircuts are $48.  Children’s haircuts are $36.  If Tayzia wants to give a 20% tip to the hair stylist, how much would it be?
task_context.reference_solution:
The two daughters’ haircuts cost $36 x 2 = $<<36*2=72>>72.
All three haircuts will cost $72 + $48 = $<<72+48=120>>120.
The tip on the haircuts is $120 x 20% = $<<120*20*.01=24>>24.
#### 24
